description: Asked after the book, was told to leave the sheet, and cut nothing.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Stayed on the hamper, studied his nails, and did not take the part.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Offered mornings from the door, and refused a cure he had not promised.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Spoke the lines exactly, cracked on the call, and finished lower.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Called the lines very good, answered the question about the lady, and stopped the book from deciding.
name: William Shakespeare
